body: I'm in favor of a warning like this, though the OP should be updated to note it's dependant on #111522
We should avoid implying it's a round-trip conversion. `best_effort_round_trip` or `partial_round_trip` might be better monikers.
I would still call it a round-trip, just a lossy one. The data is converted back into the original format, just with some of the data lost.

body:
```suggestion
				[b]Warning:[/b] The JSON specification only allows numbers written as numeric literals. Any occurrences of [constant @GDScript.INF] will be replaced with [code]1e99999[/code], Negative [constant @GDScript.INF] will be replaced with [code]-1e99999[/code], and [constant @GDScript.NAN] will be replaced with [code]null[/code]. If you rely on [constant @GDScript.NAN] or prefer an explicit way to encode [constant @GDScript.INF], consider passing your data through [method from_native] first.
```
The "-[constant @GDScript.INF]" part is a nitpick.

This is missing some context for my taste

```suggestion
					WARN_PRINT_ONCE("NaN (Not a Number) found in argument to JSON.stringify. NaN cannot be represented in JSON, so the value was replaced with null. This warning will not be printed for subsequent NaN instances.");
```

body:
I think this is more problem-oriented:

```suggestion
				[b]Warning:[/b] Non-finite numbers are not supported in JSON. Any occurrences of [constant @GDScript.INF] will be replaced with [code]1e99999[/code], and negative [constant @GDScript.INF] will be replaced with [code]-1e99999[/code], but they will be interpreted correctly as infinity by most JSON parsers. [constant @GDScript.NAN] will be replaced with [code]null[/code], and it will not be interpreted as NaN in JSON parsers. If you expect non-finite numbers, consider passing your data through [method from_native] first.
```

I will scream ['til the end of time](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111498#discussion_r2427473765) to reserve the word "instance" to a very specific meaning, if possible.

I don't know if the quotation marks and carets are appropriate, nor if "This warning will be printed once" really needs to be specified, but that would require a bigger pass for consistency across all warnings.
```suggestion
					WARN_PRINT_ONCE("`NaN` (\"Not a Number\") found in argument passed to JSON.stringify(). `NaN` cannot be represented in JSON, so the value has been replaced with `null`. This warning will not be printed for all later NaN occurrences.");
```
@aaronfranke Hold on, not solved. I still stand by my suggestion unless there's disagreements.
"Occurrences" is fine with me. Sorry, wasn't aware of the earlier conversation, but reserving "Instance" for actual object instances makes sense to me.
